title: New crate: uuencode (standalone UU encode/decode)
description:
Standalone Rust crate for UUencoding and UUdecoding.

Scope:
- No dependency on mime-tree. Usable as a general-purpose library.
- mime-tree depends on this crate for TransferEncoding::UuEncoding support (MIME-80l.3).
- Must handle real-world 'trash': CRLF, trailing-space stripping, space/backtick zero ambiguity, missing end, begin-base64 detection, multiple blocks, inline blocks with surrounding text.
- No panics on any input.

Public API shape:
  pub struct BlockMetadata { pub filename: String, pub mode: u32 }
  pub struct DecodedBlock { pub data: Vec<u8>, pub metadata: BlockMetadata, pub is_truncated: bool }
  pub struct BlockLocation { pub begin_offset: usize, pub end_offset: usize, pub metadata: BlockMetadata }
  pub enum UuError { ... }
  pub fn decode(input: &[u8]) -> Result<DecodedBlock, UuError>   // full block incl. begin/end lines
  pub fn encode(data: &[u8], filename: &str, mode: u32) -> Vec<u8>  // produces begin/end framing
  pub fn scan(input: &[u8]) -> impl Iterator<Item = Result<BlockLocation, UuError>>  // finds blocks in text

Crate name: uuencoding
Located at: uuencoding/ in this workspace (or as a sibling workspace)
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0
MSRV: 1.75 (no mime-tree dep, so can match the lower bar)
